symbols.name: _AnyModifiedContent

symbols.name: _AroundApplyingModifier

symbols.name: _ConditionalContent

symbols.name: _IdentifiedView

symbols.name: _MemoizedView
symbols.abstract: Composition's explicit reuse seam; ordinary views keep conservative input comparison.

symbols.name: _PrimitiveView

symbols.name: _ScopeApplyingModifier

symbols.name: _SourceLocatedView
symbols.abstract: Transparent to node identity, keyed reconciliation and state reflection.

symbols.name: _StateErased
symbols.abstract: Existential helper so `CompositionScope` can wire state observers without knowing the concrete value type of every `@State`.

symbols.name: _StateReadTrackedView
symbols.abstract: Runtime entry point synthesized by `@TrackStateReads`.

symbols.name: _StructuralView
symbols.abstract: Marker for views that don't materialise into a node themselves but expand into a sequence of child views (`TupleView`, `_ConditionalContent`, `Optional`, `Array<View>`).

symbols.name: _ViewModifier_Content
symbols.abstract: Stand-in passed to `ViewModifier.body(content:)`; the `ViewGraph` substitutes the actual wrapped content at materialisation time.

symbols.name: AccessibilityActions
symbols.abstract: Closures operate on the same controlled bindings as pointer and keyboard input.

symbols.name: AccessibilityRevision

symbols.name: AccessibilityRole
symbols.abstract: Platform-neutral meaning of a scene element. Geometry and actions remain runtime data.

symbols.name: AccessibilityValueProvider
symbols.abstract: Large values are materialized only when an assistive client asks for them. A cheap revision lets platform bridges publish changes without reading text.

symbols.name: ActiveAnimationContext
symbols.abstract: Per-frame context that records the `Animation` (if any) under which the current recomposition is running, plus the completion callback waiting on it. Modifier `apply` paths read `current` when they detect that a node property is changing, and — if non-nil — register an `AnimationController` instead of writing the new value directly.

symbols.name: Align
symbols.abstract: Cross-axis alignment (maps to `YGAlign`).

symbols.name: Animation
symbols.abstract: Description of how a value should transition to its target. Pure value type; the runtime scheduler consumes this when building per-property `AnimationController` instances.

symbols.name: AnimationCompletionCriteria
symbols.abstract: When a `withAnimation` completion callback should run.

symbols.name: AnimationCurve
symbols.abstract: Easing curve mapping normalized time `t ∈ [0, 1]` to progress. Overshooting curves can return progress outside `[0, 1]`. Pure value type with no theme dependency — Phase 7.5's `Easing` struct lives in the Compose layer and feeds into `Animation` via `.cubicBezier(...)` here when needed.

symbols.name: AnimationKeyframe
symbols.abstract: One target and the timing used to reach it from the previous keyframe.

symbols.name: AnyAnimationController
symbols.abstract: Common interface for the scheduler. Each controller owns a single animated value and writes the interpolated result via its `apply` closure on every tick.

symbols.name: AnyView
symbols.abstract: Type-eraser for `View`. Stores an arbitrary view value; `ViewGraph` recognises `AnyView` and recurses into `storage` directly, so user code can hand around heterogeneous view trees without fighting the type system.

symbols.name: BidiClass
symbols.abstract: Unicode bidirectional character types (UAX #9, table 4). Explicit embeddings and isolates are treated as boundary neutrals; marks (LRM, RLM, ALM) keep their strong types.

symbols.name: BidiParagraphs
symbols.abstract: Resolved embedding levels for every UTF-8 byte of a text. Each hard line break starts a paragraph with its own base direction (first strong character, or the caller's default when none is found).

symbols.name: Binding
symbols.abstract: A bidirectional reference to a mutable value owned elsewhere.

symbols.name: Box
symbols.abstract: A flexible container with explicit flex direction. Most layout primitives (`Row`, `Column`) are thin wrappers around `Box`.

symbols.name: BoxSizing
symbols.abstract: Box sizing model (maps to `YGBoxSizing`).

symbols.name: ClipboardHolder
symbols.abstract: Process-wide clipboard bridge (genuinely global: one system pasteboard).

symbols.name: Color
symbols.abstract: sRGB-encoded RGB and straight alpha in the 0..1 float range.

symbols.name: Column
symbols.abstract: Vertical stack — Box with `flexDirection: .column`.

symbols.name: ComponentRecompositionMetrics
symbols.abstract: Counts body evaluations, excluding the initial mount. Durations include body evaluation and reconciliation, but exclude Yoga layout and GPU rendering.

symbols.name: ComponentSourceLocation
symbols.abstract: Compiler-captured source coordinates. fileID stays readable across machines; filePath can be remapped by the Inspector when the app was built elsewhere.

symbols.name: ContainerSizeReader
symbols.abstract: Reports the content-box size of its own subtree after every layout pass, so content can adapt to the space actually available to it — a container query rather than a window query. The selected branch of a candidate layout only sees the proposal; this reader sees the measured result.

symbols.name: ContentScaleHolder
symbols.abstract: Process-wide content scale used by vector-image rasterizers (SVG/PDF). Hosts publish the active drawable scale so SVG icons can be rasterized at physical-pixel resolution and stay crisp on HiDPI displays.

symbols.name: DecodedImage
symbols.abstract: Raw RGBA8 bitmap with straight (non-premultiplied) alpha. Width/height are in pixels; `pixels.count == width * height * 4`. The byte order is `[R, G, B, A]`, top-left origin, which matches what `DrawListRenderer.registerColorTexture(...)` expects.

symbols.name: Direction
symbols.abstract: Text/layout direction (maps to `YGDirection`).

symbols.name: DirtyReason
symbols.abstract: One recorded invalidation event.

symbols.name: Display
symbols.abstract: Display type (maps to `YGDisplay`).

symbols.name: DrawBatch
symbols.abstract: One contiguous draw call, all sharing the same texture and scissor rect.

symbols.name: DrawListAtlasDirty
symbols.abstract: Atlas upload payload captured on the main thread and consumed by the render thread.

symbols.name: DrawListResources
symbols.abstract: Ownership carried with cached geometry and cross-thread snapshots. A renderer may borrow these resources until it has submitted the draw list.

symbols.name: DrawListSnapshot
symbols.abstract: Immutable snapshot of one frame's in-game UI draw commands, safe to pass across the main→render thread boundary.

symbols.name: DynamicProperty
symbols.abstract: Marker protocol for property wrappers managed by the composition system.

symbols.name: Edge
symbols.abstract: Box edge selector (maps to `YGEdge`).

symbols.name: ElementID
symbols.abstract: Opaque, monotonically allocated identifier for a runtime element.

symbols.name: EmptyView
symbols.abstract: A view that displays nothing and produces no nodes.

symbols.name: EventPhase
symbols.abstract: Phase of event delivery in the capture/target/bubble model.

symbols.name: EventResult
symbols.abstract: Result of a handler — `handled` stops bubble (and capture if returned in capture phase).

symbols.name: FlexDirection
symbols.abstract: Flex layout direction (maps to `YGFlexDirection`).

symbols.name: FocusChainHolder
symbols.abstract: Holds the active window's focus chain (focus-aware primitives read it).

symbols.name: FocusRevision
symbols.abstract: Bumped when any property that decides sequential focus / subtree input eligibility changes. Focus-dependent containers cache their scan against this counter instead of walking the tree on every layout pass.

symbols.name: Gutter
symbols.abstract: Gutter (gap) axis selector (maps to `YGGutter`).

symbols.name: HeightClassReader
symbols.abstract: Reads only the surface height class into application content.

symbols.name: HitResult
symbols.abstract: Result of a hit test — the deepest hit-testable node containing the point, plus the chain from root → node for capture/bubble traversal.

symbols.name: HitTester
symbols.abstract: Hit-tests a `Node` tree against a window-local point.

symbols.name: HorizontalAlignment
symbols.abstract: Common alignment vocabulary mapped to Yoga's alignment enums.

symbols.name: HoverPhase
symbols.abstract: Boundary transition derived from mouse-motion hit-test changes.

symbols.name: ImmutableViewInput
symbols.abstract: Explicit value semantics for inputs that capture behavior. Equal values must be interchangeable, including their callbacks. Mutable references do not satisfy this contract merely because they expose an Equatable conformance.

symbols.name: InputHandlerRole
symbols.abstract: Semantic role attached to an input handler. Dispatch still works without roles, but richer roles let the router resolve chrome/focus/viewport conflicts without hard-coding component types.

symbols.name: InputHandlerRoute
symbols.abstract: Metadata for a node handler in the input routing table.

symbols.name: InputRoutingPriority
symbols.abstract: Coarse priority band used by the dispatcher before falling back to normal tree order. Values are intentionally spaced so future app layers can insert intermediate priorities without changing the enum cases.

symbols.name: InteractionRegistryHolder
symbols.abstract: Holds the active window's interaction registry.

symbols.name: Interpolatable
symbols.abstract: Linearly-blendable values. Overshooting easing can supply `t` outside `[0, 1]`; numeric and geometry interpolation preserve that progress. Callers choose curves appropriate for the animated property's bounds.

symbols.name: InvalidationLogHolder
symbols.abstract: Per-window holder for the active invalidation log. Phase 1 uses an implicit current-window holder so existing call sites can record without being plumbed an explicit log reference. Set by `PlatformWindowSession`'s `withCurrent { ... }` scope.

symbols.name: InvalidationPhase
symbols.abstract: Which subsystem the dirtiness applies to.

symbols.name: InvalidationSource
symbols.abstract: Why a node was marked dirty.

symbols.name: Justify
symbols.abstract: Main-axis alignment (maps to `YGJustify`).

symbols.name: KeyframeTimeline
symbols.abstract: An immutable track with explicit targets. Sampling is independent of frame cadence; a large tick can cross any number of segments without losing time.

symbols.name: KeyPhase
symbols.abstract: Distinguishes key-down from key-up within keyboard delivery.

symbols.name: LayeredShadow
symbols.abstract: A raised surface's shadow: an ambient halo beneath a tighter key shadow.

symbols.name: Layout
symbols.abstract: Implement only the geometry of a container. Ordinary child views need no adaptation. Measurement must be deterministic and must not mutate UI state.

symbols.name: LayoutPass
symbols.abstract: Applies Yoga layout results back to the `Node` tree in a single depth-first pass.

symbols.name: LayoutSubview
symbols.abstract: A short-lived value used during measurement and placement. It exposes no nodes, storage, lifecycle, or mutable view state.

symbols.name: LayoutValueKey
symbols.abstract: A per-child value a custom `Layout` reads from its subviews, such as a grid cell's span. Values live with the child's layout node, so children declare them with `.layoutValue(key:value:)` and need no wrapper type.

symbols.name: LinearTimingCurve
symbols.abstract: A normalized piecewise linear timing curve. Construction validates the authored points once; evaluation locates a segment in O(log n).

symbols.name: LineBreaks
symbols.abstract: Line-break opportunities for mixed Latin and CJK prose: after spaces, around ideographs (with the common kinsoku exceptions) and after hyphens or slashes inside long words such as URLs.

symbols.name: MemoizedView
symbols.abstract: Explicit parent-input equality. Include every input that changes content or callbacks in `key`. Local state and environment invalidations still run.

symbols.name: ModifiedContent
symbols.abstract: A view paired with a modifier — produced by `View.modifier(_:)`.

symbols.name: NativeMenuPresenter
symbols.abstract: Holds the native menu presenter, injected by the platform shell. When set, context menus and menu buttons build a system menu (NSMenu / Win32 / GTK) instead of a self-drawn panel; when nil, the in-app menu is the fallback.

symbols.name: NodeRenderer
symbols.abstract: Walks a `Node` tree post-layout and emits draw commands into a `DrawList`.

symbols.name: NodeResource
symbols.abstract: An external registration owned by a node's lifetime.

symbols.name: NodeTransform
symbols.abstract: How a node scales its own subtree, and about which point.

symbols.name: OrientationReader
symbols.abstract: Reads whether the surface is portrait or landscape. Square counts as landscape.

symbols.name: Overflow
symbols.abstract: Overflow behavior (maps to `YGOverflow`).

symbols.name: PointerCaptureAttachmentKey
symbols.abstract: Controls can cancel a pending press when an ancestor gesture takes capture. The callback must not acquire or release capture; the transfer is already complete.

symbols.name: PointerCaptureHolder
symbols.abstract: Holds the active window's pointer-capture target (drag-driven primitives).

symbols.name: PointerPhase
symbols.abstract: Distinguishes button-down from button-up within the unified pointer handler.

symbols.name: PositionedGlyph
symbols.abstract: A shaped glyph combined with its atlas UV and screen position.

symbols.name: PositionType
symbols.abstract: Position type (maps to `YGPositionType`).

symbols.name: ProposedViewSize
symbols.abstract: A proposal expresses the space a parent offers, in logical points. A nil axis asks for intrinsic size; zero asks for the smallest fitting size. Fixed child dimensions and minimums may exceed the offered space.

symbols.name: ReducedMotionEnvironment
symbols.abstract: Application-owned accessibility preference. A nearer provider may override an ancestor; loading indicators keep a visible static form when enabled.

symbols.name: Row
symbols.abstract: Horizontal stack — Box with `flexDirection: .row`.

symbols.name: RubberBand
symbols.abstract: Maps a raw overscroll past a scroll bound onto the smaller, progressively stiffening distance that is actually drawn — the rubber band.

symbols.name: Scancode
symbols.abstract: SDL/USB-HID keyboard scancodes shared by compose controls. One named constant per key the components handle — no scattered magic numbers.

symbols.name: ScopedAmbient
symbols.abstract: A per-window ambient owned by a higher layer (e.g. CoveUICompose's portal store, which cannot live in the runtime layer) that must be made "current" exactly while this window's context is current. `PlatformInputContext` activates it on `withCurrent` entry and runs the returned restore closure on exit, so the higher-layer ambient is swapped in lockstep with the runtime registries — there is no second, independently-managed global (坏味 #3).

symbols.name: ScrollConsumePolicy
symbols.abstract: Controls whether a wheel handler should consume an event after applying scroll math.

symbols.name: ScrollMomentumSettings
symbols.abstract: Tuning for inertial scrolling — the glide that carries content along after the input that produced it has stopped.

symbols.name: ScrollPhysics
symbols.abstract: How a scrollable container reacts to input that pushes it past its bounds.

symbols.name: ScrollRubberBandSettings
symbols.abstract: Tuning for the rubber-band stretch applied when a scroll offset travels past one of its bounds.

symbols.name: ScrollSettleSettings
symbols.abstract: Tuning for the spring that returns an overscrolled offset back inside its bounds once input stops.

symbols.name: ScrollSpring
symbols.abstract: Analytic damped spring in visible logical coordinates. Solving the motion directly keeps interruptions and uneven frames independent of substeps.

symbols.name: ScrollVelocityTracker
symbols.abstract: Estimates how fast, along one axis, the user is scrolling — in points per second — from a stream of position samples.

symbols.name: ShapedGlyph
symbols.abstract: A single glyph produced by HarfBuzz shaping.

symbols.name: Spacer
symbols.abstract: Greedy spacer that absorbs free space along the parent's main axis.

symbols.name: SpringSolution
symbols.abstract: The closed-form solution of a damped spring released from a given position and velocity.

symbols.name: State
symbols.abstract: A property wrapper for view-local mutable state.

symbols.name: StateReadTracking
symbols.abstract: Composition scopes supply invalidation without introducing a Core → Scene dependency.

symbols.name: SurfaceReader
symbols.abstract: Reads per-surface capabilities without coupling content to a native host.

symbols.name: SurfaceShadow
symbols.abstract: One layer of a surface's drop shadow.

symbols.name: TextAlignment
symbols.abstract: Text alignment for multi-line layout.

symbols.name: TextEditActions
symbols.abstract: Connects platform menu commands to the same history used by text shortcuts.

symbols.name: TextInputClient
symbols.abstract: A focused editor's UTF-16 view for platform input methods. The editor owns text, grapheme boundaries, history and composition.

symbols.name: TextLayout
symbols.abstract: Performs multi-line text layout by combining shaping results with font atlas metrics.

symbols.name: TextLayoutCacheEntry
symbols.abstract: Cached pair of `(key, result)` stored on a `LayoutNode`.

symbols.name: TextLayoutCacheKey
symbols.abstract: Cache key covering every input that can change a `TextLayoutResult`.

symbols.name: TextLayoutResult
symbols.abstract: Result of text layout.

symbols.name: TextLine
symbols.abstract: A single line of laid-out text.

symbols.name: TextMeasureInputs
symbols.abstract: Inputs to text shaping/layout that we use to detect "the measurement would change" between recompose passes (so we know when to mark the LayoutNode dirty).

symbols.name: TupleView
symbols.abstract: Variadic view container produced by `@ViewBuilder` for 2+ children.

symbols.name: UIBackdrop
symbols.abstract: A frosted backdrop: the renderer blurs whatever was already drawn inside `rect` and composites the result underneath the batch this is attached to.

symbols.name: UIClip
symbols.abstract: A clip for a container's content: the GPU scissor rectangle plus an optional rounded mask applied to geometry on the CPU.

symbols.name: UIEnvironment
symbols.abstract: Transient surface capabilities. Layout follows available space and input, so a tablet with a keyboard can use the same controls as a desktop window.

symbols.name: UILinearGradient
symbols.abstract: A two-stop linear gradient across a shape's bounds.

symbols.name: UIRect
symbols.abstract: Axis-aligned rectangle in screen-space pixels (top-left origin).

symbols.name: UIReveal
symbols.abstract: Show the frame being rendered *through* the frame that was already on screen, inside a circle.

symbols.name: UIShader
symbols.abstract: WGSL source for the UI renderer.

symbols.name: UITextureAsset
symbols.abstract: CPU texture ownership consumed by a GPU renderer, independent of decoding.

symbols.name: UIVertex
symbols.abstract: Vertex format used by the UI render pipeline.

symbols.name: UIWorkSchedulerHolder
symbols.abstract: Process-wide bridge for work that must run on the UI run-loop thread.

symbols.name: View
symbols.abstract: The fundamental view protocol — every UI element conforms to `View`.

symbols.name: ViewBuilder
symbols.abstract: Result builder used to compose views inside container bodies.

symbols.name: ViewModifier
symbols.abstract: Modifies a view by wrapping or transforming its content.

symbols.name: WidthClassReader
symbols.abstract: Reads only the surface width class into application content.

symbols.name: Wrap
symbols.abstract: Flex wrap (maps to `YGWrap`).

symbols.name: AnimationCompletionGroup
symbols.abstract: One `withAnimation` completion callback, plus the controllers it is waiting on.

symbols.name: AnimationController
symbols.abstract: Drives one `Interpolatable` value from `from` to `to` over the lifetime of an `Animation`. The controller is value-agnostic — it does not know which property it writes; the caller's `apply` closure handles that (typically `{ value in node.backgroundColor = value }`).

symbols.name: AnimatorScheduler
symbols.abstract: Per-thread registry of in-flight animation controllers. The platform shell calls `tick(deltaTime:)` once per frame on the UI thread. Finished controllers drop out automatically on the next tick.

symbols.name: CompositionLocal
symbols.abstract: A typed key for passing values implicitly down the composition tree.

symbols.name: compositionLocal
symbols.abstract: Provide `value` for `local` to every descendant of this view. Nearer providers override farther ones; consumers fall back to `local.defaultValue` when no provider is reachable.

symbols.name: DrawList
symbols.abstract: CPU-side command buffer for the UI renderer.

symbols.name: EventDispatcher
symbols.abstract: Routes window-local input events to nodes in the CoveUI tree.

symbols.name: FocusAccessoryResource
symbols.abstract: A portal's logical scope relationship has exactly the portal node's lifetime.

symbols.name: FocusChain
symbols.abstract: Tracks the currently focused node and provides tab-order traversal.

symbols.name: id
symbols.abstract: Tag this view with a stable identifier. Used by the reconciler to preserve state across reorder and structural change.

symbols.name: IdentityAllocator
symbols.abstract: Process-wide allocator for `ElementID`s. Thread-safe.

symbols.name: InteractionRegistry
symbols.abstract: Per-node handler closures registered by Compose-layer modifiers.

symbols.name: InvalidationLog
symbols.abstract: Bounded ring buffer of recent `DirtyReason` entries.

symbols.name: LayerAwareNodeRenderer
symbols.abstract: Executes a flat paint plan and records each layer-root subtree into its own cached `DrawList`, then composites cached layer slices into the frame `DrawList` by appending their vertices/indices.

symbols.name: layoutDirection
symbols.abstract: Logical leading/trailing edges, flex rows, and custom layouts inherit this direction. Explicit physical left/right positions stay physical.

symbols.name: LayoutNode
symbols.abstract: Wraps a `YGNodeRef` and owns its lifetime.

symbols.name: LayoutTree
symbols.abstract: Phase 3 wrapper around the Yoga-backed layout tree. Phase 6 dropped the auxiliary `TextMeasureCache` (NSMapTable) — the per-`LayoutNode` text measure cache now lives directly on `LayoutNode.textMeasure` as a typed stored property in Runtime. Phase 7 removed the `LayoutTreeHolder` shim because no primitive reads the active LayoutTree by global lookup any more.

symbols.name: ModalFocusResource
symbols.abstract: Restores the previous focus when a modal subtree leaves the window.

symbols.name: Node
symbols.abstract: A retained-mode node in the CoveUI scene tree.

symbols.name: NodeTree
symbols.abstract: Owns the root node and drives depth-first traversal.

symbols.name: OffscreenView
symbols.abstract: Main-thread owner of an offscreen view tree. Rendering returns an owned snapshot that can be recorded later on the renderer's thread.

symbols.name: paintScaled
symbols.abstract: Custom painters use layout lengths. Resolve their geometry and local clips into the same scaled space as the node's surface, without changing layout.

symbols.name: PerformanceTimeline
symbols.abstract: Bounded, opt-in CPU timeline owned and accessed by the scene thread. Parent component spans include child work, preserving nesting in exports.

symbols.name: PlatformInputContext
symbols.abstract: Runtime services bound to one platform window.

symbols.name: PointerCapture
symbols.abstract: Tracks an explicit pointer-capture target.

symbols.name: Recomposer
symbols.abstract: A window's transaction scheduler. Dirty scopes publish jobs; the scheduler orders ancestors before descendants and consumes work evaluated by a parent transaction. Scene mutation remains on the owning UI executor.

symbols.name: RenderObject
symbols.abstract: Retained geometry and layer classification for one scene node.

symbols.name: RenderTree
symbols.abstract: Retained render records and a memoised linear paint plan.

symbols.name: ScrollAnimator
symbols.abstract: Owns every kind of motion one scrollable offset can have: the inertia that carries content along after input stops, the rubber band it stretches against past its bounds, and the spring that brings it back.

symbols.name: sourceLocation
symbols.abstract: Mark explicit-return bodies, erased/manual child lists or generated views. Default compiler arguments capture this call, not this helper's file.

symbols.name: StateRegistry
symbols.abstract: Scene-thread registry. Values are evaluated only for explicitly watched IDs. Registration exposes a read-only summary and never installs a write handler.

symbols.name: surfaceEnvironment
symbols.abstract: Usually provided by the application host; override for previews or an embedded surface.

symbols.name: ViewGraph
symbols.abstract: Materialises `View` trees into the underlying `NodeTree`, and recomposes affected subtrees when `@State` writes invalidate them through `Recomposer`.

symbols.name: CoveUICompose
symbols.abstract: CoveUI Compose — 占位模块

symbols.name: JumpArc
symbols.abstract: A ballistic parabola in window space.

symbols.name: PetPose
symbols.abstract: A named in-place silhouette. These are the ONLY things a sprite frame encodes; they never carry a position.

symbols.name: PetRenderState
symbols.abstract: Per-frame evaluation of the pet, already in window space. The view is a pure function of this value.

symbols.name: PetSpriteSheet
symbols.abstract: Maps a pose to a source image file. Kept as data so the pet core is agnostic to any particular art pack — the demo supplies the files.

symbols.name: PetTrip
symbols.abstract: A single "from one perch to another" journey. The whole body of the jump is a deterministic evaluation of `elapsed` over this timeline — there are no discrete per-phase timers to drift or desync.

symbols.name: petAnchor
symbols.abstract: Mark this view as a pet perch with the given identifier.

symbols.name: PetWorldLocal
symbols.abstract: Implicit channel for the active pet world. `PetScene` provides it; anchor nodes consume it, so `.petAnchor(_:)` needs no explicit world reference.

symbols.name: ColorGlyphSource
symbols.abstract: Platform fonts provide metrics and a straight-alpha RGBA bitmap without coupling paragraph layout or atlas storage to a platform rasterizer.

symbols.name: Divider
symbols.abstract: Thin one-pixel separator. Renders as a coloured rect; defaults to a flexible horizontal line when placed in a Column. When `color` is omitted, the divider resolves `theme.colors.divider` from the active theme so themed scopes paint a coherent rule colour without any plumbing at the call site.

symbols.name: FontAxis
symbols.abstract: One design axis of a variable font, in normalized design units.

symbols.name: FontFaceSelector
symbols.abstract: A selector identifying one face inside a font file.

symbols.name: FontRun
symbols.abstract: A contiguous text segment that should be shaped with a specific font.

symbols.name: GlyphBitmap
symbols.abstract: A rasterized glyph together with the metrics layout needs for it.

symbols.name: LocalizedStringKey
symbols.abstract: A type-safe key for localized strings.

symbols.name: MarkdownView
symbols.abstract: Renders CommonMark with the GitHub extensions (tables, strikethrough, task lists): headings, paragraphs with inline styles and links, quotes, nested lists, code blocks that scroll sideways instead of wrapping, tables and rules. It takes the surrounding text style and width and grows to its content; place it in a `ScrollView` for long documents.

symbols.name: RichText
symbols.abstract: A paragraph of styled runs that wrap together: bold, italic, inline code, strikethrough and links in one flow, with the surrounding text style, foreground and `TextScaler` applied once.

symbols.name: RichTextRun
symbols.abstract: One styled span of a `RichText` paragraph. Runs wrap together as a single paragraph; a `"\n"` inside a run is a hard line break.

symbols.name: RichTextTraits
symbols.abstract: Inline presentation traits of one `RichTextRun`.

symbols.name: RopeChunk
symbols.abstract: A parser can read from the requested byte without materializing the document.

symbols.name: Script
symbols.abstract: Common ISO 15924 script tags, spelled out so callers never need HarfBuzz.

symbols.name: Text
symbols.abstract: Static text primitive. Participates in flexbox layout via Yoga's measure callback so a label sized by its parent will wrap; an unconstrained label reports its natural single-line width.

symbols.name: TextBuffer
symbols.abstract: Immutable text with shared Rope subtrees. Copying a buffer or retaining an undo snapshot is O(1). Editing visits the search path and affected graphemes. Character indexes are Swift extended grapheme clusters; byte indexes are UTF-8.

symbols.name: TextCacheLimits
symbols.abstract: Limits apply independently to shaping and layout. Bytes estimate retained strings and result buffers, rather than the process's physical footprint.

symbols.name: TextDiagnostics
symbols.abstract: An immutable interval index. Build when a diagnostic reply changes; paint and hover query only overlapping ranges, including zero-width diagnostics.

symbols.name: TextDirection
symbols.abstract: Text direction for shaping.

symbols.name: TextEditDelta
symbols.abstract: UTF-8 spans feed Tree-sitter. LSP ranges must be converted to UTF-16 positions.

symbols.name: TextEditorAnnotations
symbols.abstract: Optional caller-owned document-session annotations. This value is deliberately separate from source text, undo snapshots and persisted project configuration.

symbols.name: TextEditorFolding
symbols.abstract: Language services supply logical regions; the field owns only presentation. Omit collapsedLines for a node-local session, or bind it to caller-owned state.

symbols.name: TextEditorGutter
symbols.abstract: Breakpoints belong to the caller's document session, never the source text. Editing rebases them; callbacks can forward the resulting list to a debugger.

symbols.name: TextField

symbols.name: TextFieldCaretState

symbols.name: TextFieldDecoration

symbols.name: TextFieldHoverAnchor
symbols.abstract: Where the pointer is resting inside a ``TextField``, in editor terms.

symbols.name: TextFieldLayout
symbols.abstract: Authored layout settings. Cursor, selection, IME and scrolling remain node-local.

symbols.name: TextFieldNavigation

symbols.name: TextFoldRegion
symbols.abstract: Retains the header line and hides the following lines through the closing line.

symbols.name: TextGutterLabels
symbols.abstract: Names are functions so applications can localize word order and line numbers.

symbols.name: TextInsertFormat
symbols.abstract: How a completion's `insertText` is interpreted.

symbols.name: TextSelectionRoot
symbols.abstract: Owns the selection for its content and offers Copy / Select All on secondary click or a touch long press.

symbols.name: FontAtlas
symbols.abstract: Packs FreeType alpha glyphs and registered color glyphs into separate atlas planes.

symbols.name: FontCollection
symbols.abstract: An ordered set of owned font faces sharing one alpha atlas. This performs grapheme-safe fallback and script-run shaping; paragraph bidi is a host concern. Like FreeType and DrawList, instances belong to one render thread.

symbols.name: FontFace

symbols.name: FontProvider
symbols.abstract: Resolves system fonts and provides shaping for text runs.

symbols.name: ManagedFont
symbols.abstract: A font resolved for rendering, with its runtime identity.

symbols.name: NativeColorGlyphFont
symbols.abstract: Native bitmap/color fonts use CoreText for both metrics and rasterization. They share the same positioned-glyph layout as normal HarfBuzz runs.

symbols.name: RopeLeaf
symbols.abstract: Valid UTF-8, cut only at extended grapheme boundaries. A single grapheme can exceed the nominal chunk size (for example a long sequence of combining marks); preserving that grapheme takes precedence over the 1024-byte packing target.

symbols.name: TextEditHistory
symbols.abstract: Per-document text transactions. Selection is restored with the text; a new edit after undo discards the redo branch. Adjacent typing/deletion coalesces.

symbols.name: TextFontResolver
symbols.abstract: Lazily creates sized/weighted `FontProvider`s that share a single atlas. Each provider gets its own font-ID range so glyph rasterization remains unambiguous even when multiple sizes are used in the same frame.

symbols.name: textSelection

symbols.name: textSelectionActions
symbols.abstract: Adds Look Up and Share to the selection menu of the enclosing `textSelection()` region. Each entry appears only when its action is supplied; without them the menu offers Copy and Select All.

symbols.name: TextSelectionScope
symbols.abstract: One selection shared by every paragraph of a document, so a drag can run from a heading through a list into a code block and copy as one string. Transient view state: owned by the mounted root, never persisted.

symbols.name: TextShaper
symbols.abstract: Shapes text with HarfBuzz through a face owned by `CoveUIText`.

symbols.name: AdaptiveSidebar
symbols.abstract: One navigation tree and one content tree across sidebar, rail and drawer layouts. Breakpoints use this container's allocation. Optional presentation belongs to the caller's session and survives a temporary return to the expanded layout.

symbols.name: Carousel
symbols.abstract: A paged view: one page fills the viewport, the rest are one gesture away.

symbols.name: CarouselAutoplay
symbols.abstract: Automatic advance for a `Carousel`. Rotation pauses while the pointer is over the carousel or keyboard focus is inside it, restarts its interval after any manual page change, and always offers a pause control. With reduced motion it starts paused.

symbols.name: CarouselIndicator
symbols.abstract: How a carousel shows position. `.automatic` uses dots up to eight pages and a "3 / 12" count beyond, where dots stop being countable.

symbols.name: CarouselPage
symbols.abstract: One page of a `Carousel`.

symbols.name: DisclosureGroup
symbols.abstract: A keyboard-focusable disclosure header with naturally sized content. Expansion belongs to the caller, so it survives panel reconstruction and can also be controlled by search or an Expand All command.

symbols.name: FrameModifier
symbols.abstract: Omitted dimensions preserve the content's own sizing. Use `.auto` to explicitly return an axis to intrinsic sizing.

symbols.name: Grid
symbols.abstract: Places each direct child in one cell. Use `LazyGrid` for large collections.

symbols.name: GridColumn
symbols.abstract: Width policy for one grid column. An adaptive column expands into as many columns as its allocated width can hold. Children occupy one cell each.

symbols.name: GridLayout

symbols.name: GridRowHeights
symbols.abstract: Authored row heights for `LazyGrid`. Supply unscaled logical heights; LazyGrid applies the active TextScaler.

symbols.name: GridSpan
symbols.abstract: Cells a grid child covers. Spans are clamped to the resolved column count; named field columns ignore spans because hiding a field column would otherwise move every spanning cell.

symbols.name: LayoutThatFits
symbols.abstract: Selects the first layout whose measured size fits every specified proposal axis. The last candidate is the fallback even when it overflows.

symbols.name: LazyGrid
symbols.abstract: A vertically scrolling, equal-column grid that constructs only visible rows plus overscan. Row heights are explicit so scrolling never measures the full collection. Stable item identities preserve overlapping cells. Row heights and row spacing are authored logical values and follow TextScaler once. Row state that must survive leaving the viewport belongs in the model.

symbols.name: LetterSpacingModifier
symbols.abstract: Additional logical space between shaped clusters, shared by measure and draw.

symbols.name: Masonry
symbols.abstract: Convenience wrapper around `MasonryLayout`.

symbols.name: MasonryLayout
symbols.abstract: A balanced waterfall layout: each child is measured at the column width and placed in the currently shortest column. Rows are not fixed, so cards with different heights pack without leaving the vertical gaps a row grid leaves.

symbols.name: NavigationDrawer
symbols.abstract: Modal navigation, sharing Sidebar destinations and the standard modal lifecycle. The application owns presentation and selection, so resizing never resets them.

symbols.name: NavigationRail
symbols.abstract: Compact destination navigation. Applications choose it for medium/expanded surfaces and use NavigationDrawer for compact surfaces.

symbols.name: Overlay
symbols.abstract: Base view plus one overlay child. The base owns the measured size; the overlay is aligned inside those bounds and may paint outside them if larger.

symbols.name: OverlayLayout
symbols.abstract: Places overlay content on top of the base view without changing the base's measured size. This is the layout behind `.overlay(alignment:content:)`.

symbols.name: Panel
symbols.abstract: Surface container with a labelled header bar. Visual chrome is delegated to the active `PanelStyle` (defaults to `DefaultPanelStyle`); call sites only supply title, optional accessory, and content.

symbols.name: ResizableEditor
symbols.abstract: Vertical resize surface for multiline/code inputs. Drag the bottom grip; content owns its text scrolling and the parent owns its surrounding layout.

symbols.name: ResizableTextArea
symbols.abstract: Multiline input with a draggable lower edge and internal text scrolling.

symbols.name: SafeArea
symbols.abstract: Insets supplied by the host are consumed once, by the selected logical edges. Nested SafeArea containers receive only the remaining edges.

symbols.name: ScrollPhysicsEnvironment
symbols.abstract: Scroll overscroll behaviour shared by every scrollable container below the provider.

symbols.name: ScrollRequest
symbols.abstract: One declarative programmatic scroll. A new identity starts a new animation; a duration of zero (or reduced motion) snaps immediately.

symbols.name: ScrollView
symbols.abstract: Clipped scrolling with optional offset binding and viewport observations. Content must retain its natural extent on the scrolling axis, e.g. a no-shrink column. Use a virtualized collection for large datasets.

symbols.name: Sidebar
symbols.abstract: Navigation chrome with independent header/footer slots and one Tab stop among enabled destinations.

symbols.name: SidebarItemSlots

symbols.name: SidebarPresentation
symbols.abstract: Present the same destination nodes as a full sidebar or a narrow rail.

symbols.name: SidebarResizeOptions
symbols.abstract: Bounds for a caller-owned sidebar width. Layout fitting never writes a narrower temporary allocation back into the caller's requested width.

symbols.name: SplitAxis
symbols.abstract: Orientation of a `SplitView`.

symbols.name: SplitCompactPresentation

symbols.name: SplitConstraints

Maximums constrain the divider whenever both panes can fill the container; if their sum is too small, surplus is shared in proportion to the maximums. This keeps a filling split deterministic without overflow.

symbols.name: SplitPane
symbols.abstract: The pane presented when a split has room for only one pane.

symbols.name: SplitView
symbols.abstract: Two panes sharing one axis, split by a fraction of the available space.

symbols.name: StackLayout
symbols.abstract: A natural-size stack algorithm for use in custom and candidate layouts. Children receive the offered cross-axis size and an intrinsic main axis; use Box/Row/Column when flex growth or compression is required.

symbols.name: StatusBarMetrics
symbols.abstract: One line of persistent context at the bottom of a window.

symbols.name: StatusBarText
symbols.abstract: A single status-bar cell: one short fact, optionally toned and optionally monospaced so numbers stay column-aligned while they change.

symbols.name: SurfaceRoot
symbols.abstract: Installs host surface facts once at the root of a scene: safe-area insets, text scale and reduced motion.

symbols.name: TabOverflow
symbols.abstract: What a `TabView` does when its tabs are wider than the strip.

symbols.name: TabStripPlacement
symbols.abstract: Which edge of a `TabView` holds the strip.

symbols.name: TabVariant
symbols.abstract: Visual treatment of a `TabView` strip.

symbols.name: TabView
symbols.abstract: Multi-panel container with a single active panel.

symbols.name: ViewThatFits
symbols.abstract: Selects wide or compact content using the allocated container width. Intrinsic mode mounts both branches immediately so it can measure them; hidden branches still stop paint, input and accessibility.

symbols.name: VirtualStack
symbols.abstract: A vertically scrolling stack that constructs only the rows around the viewport. Row identity survives scrolling; keep persistent row data in the model, since fully offscreen rows are unmounted. IDs must be unique.

symbols.name: ZStack
symbols.abstract: Layer children in declaration order. The last child is painted and hit first; earlier children remain mounted and keep their state.

symbols.name: ZStackLayout
symbols.abstract: Layered container. Children are measured against the available proposal and placed on top of each other in declaration order: the last child paints on top and receives pointer input before earlier children.

symbols.name: gridCellSpan
symbols.abstract: Let this child cover several `Grid` columns and/or rows. Placement is row-major: a cell that does not fit the remaining columns of a row starts the next free row.

symbols.name: overlay
symbols.abstract: Attach content to the bounds of this view without changing its measured size. symbols.name: padding
symbols.abstract: Apply asymmetric padding by axis. Equivalent to constructing an `EdgeInsets` with matching horizontal and vertical pairs.

symbols.name: safeAreaInsets
symbols.abstract: Provide host insets in logical points. Desktop hosts default to zero; platform chrome/keyboard geometry must be supplied by the owning host.

symbols.name: scrollAnchor
symbols.abstract: Marks this subtree as a scroll anchor. When content size changes, ScrollView keeps the topmost visible anchor at the same viewport position, which is what chat-history prepends need.

symbols.name: scrollPhysics
symbols.abstract: Override how descendant scrollable containers react past their bounds.

symbols.name: AppBar
symbols.abstract: A bounded application header. The host owns safe-area insets; the bar owns a full-name heading, back action and at most one/three inline commands.

symbols.name: Button

symbols.name: CalendarGranularity

symbols.name: CalendarGrid
symbols.abstract: Date arithmetic uses calendar components, so a day is not assumed to be 24 hours.

symbols.name: CalendarView
symbols.abstract: Caller-owned selection, with transient browsing and one focusable cell per grid. The title drills up from days to a year of months to twelve years; picking a cell drills back down to the selection granularity.

symbols.name: Checkbox
symbols.abstract: Mixed state represents a partially selected collection. Activation selects it fully.

symbols.name: ColorField

symbols.name: ColumnVisibility
symbols.abstract: Required columns stay available. Equal priorities preserve authored order.

symbols.name: Combobox

symbols.name: CompletionPopover

symbols.name: DateRangeCalendar

symbols.name: DateRangePreset

symbols.name: DateRangeRules

symbols.name: KeyCap

symbols.name: NumberField

symbols.name: RadioGroup
symbols.abstract: Controlled selection with one Tab stop and wrapping arrow-key navigation.

symbols.name: RatingSelection

symbols.name: SearchField

symbols.name: Slider

symbols.name: SplitButton

symbols.name: Tag
symbols.abstract: Compact labelled chip, optionally removable.

symbols.name: TimeField

symbols.name: TimeInputHourCycle
symbols.abstract: The hour cycle a `TimeInput` displays.

symbols.name: TimePicker

symbols.name: Toggle
symbols.abstract: Boolean on/off control rendered as a switch track with a movable thumb.

symbols.name: Vec3Field
symbols.abstract: Three caller-owned numeric values with a shared format and constraints.

symbols.name: WheelPicker

symbols.name: FormController
symbols.abstract: Transient validation/submission state. Authored values and persistence stay in the application.

symbols.name: NavigationStack

symbols.name: ActionSheet

symbols.name: ActionSheetAction

symbols.name: BottomSheetOptions

symbols.name: CommandItem

symbols.name: CommandPalette
symbols.abstract: Searchable command surface presented as a modal overlay.

symbols.name: Dialog

symbols.name: FocusScope

symbols.name: HoverCard

symbols.name: MenuDescriptor

symbols.name: Popconfirm

symbols.name: SelectionNavigation

symbols.name: ShortcutHost
symbols.abstract: Invisible host for application-level keyboard shortcuts.

symbols.name: ToastAction
symbols.abstract: One inline action rendered inside a toast card.

symbols.name: ToastPosition
symbols.abstract: Where toast cards are anchored inside the window.

symbols.name: Tooltip

symbols.name: TooltipAnchor

symbols.name: TooltipArbitrationHolder

symbols.name: ToastController

symbols.name: tooltip
symbols.abstract: A description that is redundant unless the target had to clip text.

symbols.name: ChartAnnotation

symbols.name: ChartBand

symbols.abstract: Counts samples into even-width bins, for a distribution chart.

symbols.name: DefaultTextFieldStyle

symbols.name: DefaultTreeRowStyle

symbols.name: EditorTextFieldStyle

symbols.name: SurfaceMotion

symbols.name: TextEmphasis
